quarterly_data.quarter: Fujikura press release: Fujikura Receives Largest-Ever Single Order for (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fujikura entered into a long-term supply agreement with Commonwealth Fusion Systems (CFS) for high-temperature superconducting (HTS) tape: CFS agreed to purchase more than 10,000 km (3 GA-m) of HTS tape for the development of its ARC fusion power plants, starting with the first grid-scale plant being developed at the Fall Line Fusion Power Station in Chesterfield County, Virginia. Fujikura is investing in the expansion of its manufacturing capacity to deliver the tape at scale. Fujikura calls it its largest-ever single order for HTS tape, and the release says the agreement is the largest of its kind for HTS tape. CEO Naoki Okada: with this agreement Fujikura will continue to strengthen its position as a key supplier of HTS tape for ARC power plants while building a long-term business platform for the 2030s and beyond, when commercial fusion power plants are expected to begin operation.
quarterly_data.figure: More than 10,000 km (3 GA-m) of HTS tape; value not stated
